thales_current_description: Fine-grained authorization, real-time synchronization, search enrichment and observability for a large industrial 3D platform.

thales_current_detail_three: Modernized the platform from Java 8 / Spring Boot 2 to Java 17 / Spring Boot 3 and expanded traces, metrics and product telemetry.

thales_apprentice_detail_two: Designed chunked GeoPackage delivery from S3 with local reconstruction for disconnected field operations.
